# Shaolin Kung-Fu Chamber of Fitness, Thrithala

> Martial arts academy in Thrithala, Palakkad district, Kerala, India. Teaches Traditional Shaolin Kung Fu, Competitive Wushu, Boxing, Kickboxing, MMA and practical self-defense to kids (from 5 years), teens, women and adults.

## Key facts

- Name: Shaolin Kung-Fu Chamber of Fitness (also known as Shaolin Kung-Fu Academy Thrithala)
- Address: Palakkad – Ponnani Road, Thrithala, Kerala 679534, India (near the Bharathapuzha riverbanks)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90486 81719
- Website: https://shaolinkungfukerala.com/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=5309736038134553420
- Class timings: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday 6:30 PM – 8:30 PM; Sunday 8:30 AM – 10:30 AM
- Instructors: certified black belt masters trained under Grandmaster Sukumar in Chennai
- Results: 26+ black belts; district and state medalists in Wushu, Boxing and Kickboxing
- Facility: fully mat-covered training hall
- Areas served: Thrithala, Pattambi, Koottanad, Kumbidi, Muthuthala, Perumpilavu and nearby parts of Palakkad district
- Languages: English and Malayalam

## Programs

- Traditional Shaolin Kung Fu: forms, stances, staff and sword routines, focus and discipline
- Competitive Wushu: split kicks, aerial jumps, tournament routines, Sanda; district and state championship preparation
- Boxing: footwork, head movement, combinations, heavy bag and mitt work
- Kickboxing: striking combinations, kicks, conditioning and fat-burning workouts
- MMA & practical self-defense: takedown defense, escapes, ground recovery, women's self-defense
- Kids martial arts & acrobatics: handstands, flips, flexibility, discipline and confidence

## Batches

- Kids: 5–12 years
- Teens: 13–17 years
- Youth & adults: 18+ years
- Women's self-defense

## Admission

Trial sessions, admission and batch fees: call or WhatsApp +91 90486 81719.
